general.Don't victory-display the Spawn: one sta: Don't put Ungoliant's Spawn in the victory display. One of the two stage 3 cards is only won by defeating it, and there is just the one copy in the deck.
general.Never take an undefended attack - shadow: Don't take undefended attacks. A few shadow cards here punish you extra hard when nobody defends: the Spawn raises your threat by 8 instead of 4, and the Hummerhorns deal 2 damage to each of your characters instead of 1.
general.Tactics starter deck lacks willpower. Pa: Don't expect the Core Set's Tactics starter to win here. It has almost no willpower, so it only gets through when the encounter deck happens to deal it enemies to kill. Pair it with another sphere.
general.Under 32 threat dodges Ungoliant's Spawn: Stay under 40 threat and the Hummerhorns will never reach you, and under 32 keeps Ungoliant's Spawn off you as well. There is little to gain below that, as the other enemies here engage cheaply anyway.

1.Forest Spider starts in staging, +1 atta: Have a defender ready in the first round or two. Setup puts a Forest Spider straight into the staging area, and at 25 engagement it will come down on you early, hitting for 3 once its Forced effect kicks in.

2.Just 2 points. Build up first - stage 3: Stage 2 is only 2 quest points, so a single quest phase will clear it. Use the time to thin out the staging area, because beating this stage drops you into one of the two stage 3 cards at random.

3.Advance with the Spawn alive but nearly: If the Spawn turns up early, don't finish it off. Wear its 9 hit points down and advance with it still alive, because one stage 3 is won by killing it and the other can't be beaten while it is in play.
